building_stock: The only records that survive the geo filter (Airtasker lock-installation and locksmith task histories for Sunshine North VIC and Sunshine West VIC) describe standalone houses with multiple hinged doors on conventional knob/handle and deadbolt hardware — one job is "Install smartlock/Deadbolt on door", another is a full smart-lock swap on a door already bored for an earlier unit ("Remove smart lock and install new smart lock and knob and also fill hole with filler if necessary"), a third is "door handles with locks for 3 doors in my house" plus a connecting bedroom-to-bathroom door blocked off, and a fourth sits alongside "install a security mesh door" — so expect retrofit onto already-modified door leaves behind a security mesh screen, with no apartment, unit or common-entrance signal appearing in any Melbourne record.
council_notes: None identified — no heritage-overlay, owners-corporation or rental-provider signal appears in any of the three surviving Melbourne records, and the only regulatory record returned for Sunshine West (Smart Start alcohol interlocks at AB Auto Electrics, a Footscray-origin auto electrical workshop) is vehicle-related and has no bearing on door hardware.
demographic_skew: Insufficient local data — recommend manual research on resident composition (no tenure, age, household or income signal survives the geo filter); the one demand-shaping behaviour the Melbourne records do evidence is install-only, customer-supplied-hardware buying — the Sunshine West task reads "Smart lock is available just need to get installed" — against thin local supply, with Airtasker listing only 8 lock installers in Sunshine North off 10 reviews.
common_concerns: Whether the new smart lock will cover the cut-out left by a previous unit, or whether the old hole has to be filled and made good — the Sunshine West locksmith job is explicitly "Remove smart lock and install new smart lock and knob and also fill hole with filler if necessary".

Finding someone who will fit a lock the homeowner has already bought rather than quoting supply-and-install — the Sunshine West lock-installation task is posted as "Smart lock is available just need to get installed".

How a smart lock works alongside a security mesh screen door at the entry, and whether the deadbolt function is kept — the same Sunshine West locksmith thread runs "I want to install a security mesh door" next to the smart-lock swap, and the Sunshine North task is framed as "Install smartlock/Deadbolt on door".

Getting several doors done in one visit, including retiring hardware that is no longer wanted — the Sunshine West request covers "door handles with locks for 3 doors in my house and also remove the door handle of a connecting bedroom to bathroom and block it off".
